title: 🧪 Add tests for safeStorageRemove
description:
### What
Added missing tests for the `safeStorageRemove` function in `app.js`.

### Coverage
Tested that when `localStorage.removeItem` throws an error, the error is caught and `UI.setElementText` is called to update the UI status with the provided failure message.

### Result
Improved overall test coverage by ensuring proper error handling during local storage removal.
